name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-paypal
description: PaymentAdapter (subsystem 08, @mercatus-liber/payments) backed by PayPal's real, documented Orders v2 API -- POST /v2/checkout/orders to create, POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture to capture, GET /v2/checkout/orders/{id} to read status -- plus real OAuth2 client-credentials token exchange (POST /v1/oauth2/token) and real webhook-signature verification via PayPal's own POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature endpoint. Proves PaymentAdapter is genuinely a second, provider-agnostic implementation (Stripe being the first), same shape as @mercatus-liber/adapter-postgres proved for persistence. Public surface is exactly PaymentAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/payments only, for the types it implements, plus global fetch as the real HTTP client (no new HTTP dependency introduced -- mirrors adapter-printful/adapter-printify/adapter-shippo's own convention).
